beta.notes_zh:
- **修复** 在 macOS 26 上打开设置「链接与预览」页面时崩溃（#70，感谢 @Yricky 的反馈）
- **修复** 开启 AI Agent 集成后，App 在极少数情况下无提示自动退出
- **优化** 大尺寸图片（如 PixPin 等截图工具复制的 TIFF）现在能完整保存与粘贴，不再因体积过大被丢弃；浏览、切换历史记录更流畅
beta.notes_en:
- **Fix** Crash when opening Settings → Link & Preview on macOS 26 (#70, thanks @Yricky for the report)
- **Fix** App could quit unexpectedly with no prompt when AI Agent integration was enabled
- **Improve** Large images (e.g. TIFF screenshots from tools like PixPin) are now saved and pasted at full resolution instead of being dropped when oversized; browsing and switching history feels smoother
